versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the obsidian-markdown skill.
- Supports creating and editing Obsidian Flavored Markdown, including wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, tags, comments, highlighting, and more.
- Covers Obsidian-specific syntax extensions in detail, with examples and references.
- Assumes basic knowledge of standard Markdown.
- Includes workflow guidance and a comprehensive example note.
